description: Use this to see whether an Idempotency-Key is in progress, done, or unknown. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. Inputs: key (required; the Idempotency-Key value). Returns {key, state, endpoint, inbox_id, message_id, created_at, expires_at, unknown_since?, last_error?}. state is in_progress, done, or unknown. unknown means an earlier send may or may not have been delivered. A missing key is HTTP 404 idempotency_key_not_found. An inbox-scoped key only sees a row for its inbox.

key.description: Idempotency-Key value, 1 to 256 characters of letters, digits, and - . _ ~.

name: cooper_get_idempotency_key
title: Get idempotency key
